findings.summary: Article backfill artifact only required summaries, which was not enough for field-level rollback.
findings.resolution: Design/spec/tasks now require full before/after values in JSON artifacts.

findings.summary: Alias merge apply did not explicitly guard against active owner collisions before writing a target alias.
findings.resolution: Design/spec/tasks now require active owner recheck and skip artifact with owner term id.

findings.summary: Production apply range was left as an open question and could permit broad writes.
findings.resolution: Design/tasks now require reviewed artifact or explicit filters and reject unbounded article apply.

findings.summary: Tests did not cover unbounded apply rejection or full artifact rollback data.
findings.resolution: Tasks now include tests for full before/after artifacts and apply rejection without reviewed scope.
